accounts_subtype_check.name: accounts_subtype_check
accounts_subtype_check.value: ("accounts"."type" = 'depository' and "accounts"."subtype" is not null and "accounts"."subtype" in ('checking', 'savings')) or ("accounts"."type" = 'credit_card' and "accounts"."subtype" is null) or ("accounts"."type" = 'loan' and "accounts"."subtype" is not null and "accounts"."subtype" in ('mortgage', 'consumer', 'other')) or ("accounts"."type" = 'investment' and "accounts"."subtype" is not null and "accounts"."subtype" in ('pea', 'assurance_vie', 'brokerage', 'other')) or ("accounts"."type" = 'property' and "accounts"."subtype" is not null and "accounts"."subtype" in ('single_family_home', 'apartment', 'second_home', 'investment_property', 'plot', 'commercial')) or ("accounts"."type" = 'vehicle' and "accounts"."subtype" is null)

entries_valuation_kind_check.name: entries_valuation_kind_check
entries_valuation_kind_check.value: ("entries"."kind" = 'valuation' and "entries"."valuation_kind" is not null and "entries"."valuation_kind" in ('opening_anchor', 'reconciliation', 'current_anchor')) or ("entries"."kind" = 'transaction' and "entries"."valuation_kind" is null) or ("entries"."kind" = 'trade' and "entries"."valuation_kind" is null)

recurrence_rules_day_check.name: recurrence_rules_day_check
recurrence_rules_day_check.value: "recurrence_rules"."day_of_month" is null or ("recurrence_rules"."day_of_month" between -1 and 31 and "recurrence_rules"."day_of_month" <> 0)

recurrence_rules_single_day_check.name: recurrence_rules_single_day_check
recurrence_rules_single_day_check.value: not ("recurrence_rules"."day_of_month" is not null and "recurrence_rules"."weekday" is not null)

recurrence_rules_shape_check.name: recurrence_rules_shape_check
recurrence_rules_shape_check.value: ("recurrence_rules"."frequency" = 'weekly' and "recurrence_rules"."weekday" is not null and "recurrence_rules"."day_of_month" is null and "recurrence_rules"."month_of_year" is null) or ("recurrence_rules"."frequency" = 'monthly' and "recurrence_rules"."day_of_month" is not null and "recurrence_rules"."weekday" is null and "recurrence_rules"."month_of_year" is null) or ("recurrence_rules"."frequency" = 'yearly' and "recurrence_rules"."day_of_month" is not null and "recurrence_rules"."weekday" is null and "recurrence_rules"."month_of_year" is not null)

rule_conditions_operator_of_type_check.name: rule_conditions_operator_of_type_check
rule_conditions_operator_of_type_check.value: ("rule_conditions"."condition_type" = 'transaction_name' and "rule_conditions"."operator" in ('like', '=')) or ("rule_conditions"."condition_type" = 'transaction_amount' and "rule_conditions"."operator" in ('>', '>=', '<', '<=', '=', '!=')) or ("rule_conditions"."condition_type" = 'transaction_account' and "rule_conditions"."operator" in ('=')) or ("rule_conditions"."condition_type" = 'transaction_merchant' and "rule_conditions"."operator" in ('=', 'is_null')) or ("rule_conditions"."condition_type" = 'transaction_category' and "rule_conditions"."operator" in ('=', 'is_null')) or ("rule_conditions"."condition_type" = 'transaction_tag' and "rule_conditions"."operator" in ('=', 'is_null')) or ("rule_conditions"."condition_type" = 'transaction_notes' and "rule_conditions"."operator" in ('like', '=', 'is_null')) or ("rule_conditions"."condition_type" = 'transaction_type' and "rule_conditions"."operator" in ('=')) or ("rule_conditions"."condition_type" = 'compound' and "rule_conditions"."operator" in ('and', 'or'))

trades_quantity_check.name: trades_quantity_check
trades_quantity_check.value: ("trades"."income_kind" is null and "trades"."quantity" <> 0) or ("trades"."income_kind" is not null and "trades"."quantity" = 0)

trades_security_check.name: trades_security_check
trades_security_check.value: "trades"."security_id" is not null or ("trades"."income_kind" is not null and "trades"."income_kind" = 'interest')
